evals.prompt: Normalize these fictional records into result.json: [{"id":" a1 ","amount":"12.50"},{"id":"b2","amount":"3"}]. Preserve order, trim ids and express amounts as integer cents. Output only records and errors arrays.

assertions.text: Records have trimmed ids and exact integer cents.

evals.prompt: Normalize [{"id":"ok","amount":"1.23"},{"id":"bad","amount":"oops"}] into result.json. Preserve valid records; report invalid amounts as {index, code}, using zero-based indexes and code invalid_amount. Output only records and errors arrays.
evals.expected_output: The valid row is retained; the malformed row has an error instead of an invented amount.

assertions.text: Invalid values are reported and valid values preserved.
